acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given I'm viewing strategy comparison, when I use effort level filters, then I can filter to show only strategies with Low, Medium, or High effort levels (multi-select or single-select toggle).
Given I'm viewing strategy comparison, when I set a minimum savings threshold (e.g., R5,000), then only strategies saving at least that amount vs baseline are displayed.
Given I apply filters, when the comparison table updates, then the WinnersPodium, DebtReductionChart, and InterestComparisonChart also update to show only filtered strategies.
Given I've decided on a strategy, when I click "Select Strategy" on any strategy row/card, then that strategy is saved as my "tracked strategy" in the uiStore.
Given I select a strategy, when the selection is saved, then the selection is persisted to Dexie settings table (`{ key: 'selectedStrategy', value: strategyId }`).
Given I select a strategy, when the action completes, then a success toast appears: "Strategy selected: [strategy name]".
Given I select a strategy, when the toast is shown, then I'm offered an option to navigate to the Track page (via toast action or modal).
Given no filters are applied (default state), when I view the Compare page, then all calculated strategies are displayed.
Given filters result in zero matching strategies, when the table updates, then an empty state message is shown: "No strategies match your filters. Try adjusting your criteria."
Given I reload the page, when filters were previously applied, then filter state should reset to default (no persistence required for filters).

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR30: User can filter comparison view to show only strategies meeting selected criteria (effort level, minimum savings threshold). FR31: User can select preferred strategy to track for validation.

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Use Zustand for UI state (selectedStrategy, filters). Pattern: useUIStore for component state, Dexie for persistent data. Selector-based re-renders for performance.

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Strategy components in src/components/strategies/. Hooks in src/hooks/. Store in src/store/. Charts in src/components/charts/.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Status Indicators: Green=Healthy/On-track, Amber=Warning/Caution, Red=Unhealthy/Critical. Effort badge colors: green=Low, amber=Medium, red=High. Always paired with icon for accessibility.

doc.title: UX Design Specification

constraints.constraint: Use Zustand for filter state (not persisted across page reload per AC-5.6.10)
Use Dexie db.settings table for selectedStrategy persistence (AC-5.6.5)
Use big.js for savings threshold comparison to avoid floating point errors
Effort badge colors: green=Low (#10b981), amber=Medium (#f59e0b), red=High (#ef4444)
Filter controls should be visually subtle, not compete with charts
Responsive: inline filter controls on desktop, stacked on mobile
Selection pattern from RecommendationCard: update uiStore, persist to Dexie, show toast with action
When all effort levels deselected, treat as "show all"
Selected row highlight: teal background/border matching recommended row style
Component naming: PascalCase for components, camelCase for hooks (useStrategyFilters)
Use shadcn/ui ToggleGroup for effort filter, Input for savings threshold

interface.name: FilterState
interface.signature: interface FilterState { effortLevels: ('low' | 'medium' | 'high')[]; minSavings: number | null; }

interface.name: useStrategyFilters
interface.signature: function useStrategyFilters(strategies: StrategyProjection[]): { filteredStrategies: StrategyProjection[]; filters: FilterState; setFilters: (filters: FilterState) => void; }

interface.name: StrategyFiltersProps
interface.signature: interface StrategyFiltersProps { strategies: StrategyProjection[]; onFiltersChange: (filters: FilterState) => void; }

interface.name: toast.success with action
interface.signature: toast.success(message, { action: { label: string, onClick: () => void } })

tests.standards: Use Vitest for all tests. Component tests use @testing-library/react with jsdom. Mock Dexie with fake-indexeddb. Follow AAA pattern (Arrange, Act, Assert). Co-locate tests in __tests__ folders or *.test.ts files.
